title: HamidDidNotEat's Adventure Modpack
description: The perfect modpack if you want to play Minecraft with the greatest mods, all in the taste of HamidDidNotEat.
body:
> **YOU NEED TO DOWNLOAD MANUALLY [THE TWILIGHT FOREST](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) MOD BEFORE YOU CAN PLAY!!!** 

_This is because modrinth doesn't support importing mods from Curseforge._



**One day, HamidDidNotEat proposed me a challenge: To make them a modpack that fits perfectly their requirements. This is what I came up with:**

[HamidDidNotEat's Adventure Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hamiddidnoteats-adventure-modpack) is a modpack focused on adding lots of content with acceptable performances.
Based on [Oculus](https://modrinth.com/mod/oculus) and [Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/embeddium), running on NeoForge, this modpack brings all of the complexity and fun from [Tinker's Construct](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct) whilst mixing it with other great dimensions mods like [The Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest). It is made to run well on most computers but if you want the most optimal conditions, here are the recommended specs:
- 4Gb+ RAM
- GPU support OpenGL 4.4+ (except 4.1 on MacOS).
- [Intel Core i5 4460](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku/80817/intel-core-i54460-processor-6m-cache-up-to-3-40-ghz/specifications.html) or later.
- M.2 Pcie 3.0+ drive

--------------

**Why should one play this modpack?**

Well, although there's not any specific reason, you might enjoy this modpack if you are searching to play Minecraft with many new dimensions, advancements, technology, smelting, adventures and much more!
It all depends how creative and how much fun you want to have!!!
